capabilities: create wikilinks spanning a range of headings
use custom separator patterns instead of the default
show hover previews for ranged links
support ranged links in embedded content
extras: The README is cut off mid-section, leaving parts of the advanced settings (visual style options) undocumented.
problem: Standard Obsidian wikilinks can only target a single heading, so linking a span of sections requires multiple links or manual workarounds.
summary: Wikilink plugin that adds ranged heading links, e.g. [[Recipe#Ingredients..Directions]], while keeping native backlink behavior.
